messages.subject: controlling the size of layout elements
parts:
First of all, thank you for the welcome, Joe :)  I'll try not to be too demanding, here.  I have a long history of programming, but more in non-web based procedural languages of long standing...

Anyway, I have another question, I searched the group here and wasn't clear on an answer.  Is there a way to control the size (and placement?) of elements in Shiny, *without* using HTML to define the entire interface?  Control of size in particular would be useful for me.  I know only enough HTML to be dangerous.. ;)  But I'm happy to use it within the ui.R script. 

If there's a way to do this, say resize a plot or a table, an example would rock.  Thank you!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: controlling the size of layout elements
parts:
You can add your own CSS to your ui.R. Here's a simple example:

tags$style(type="text/css", "#mytable { width: 450px }")

Just include that anywhere a UI component is allowed.

You can also use includeCSS.

I'm hoping to do a screencast on the contents of ui.R and how you can intermingle custom HTML/CSS/JS without dropping down to a .html file.

--

When ui.R generates HTML, it doesn't actually write anything to disk; it's just held in memory. If you'd like to see the HTML that's generated by ui.R, really the best way is to just do View Source in your browser when your app is running.
